question: The value of (0.2)³ - (0.02)³ is:
solution:
**Given:**&l
t;/p>

The value of (0.2)³ - (0.02)³

**Formula Used:**

Difference of cubes formula: a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

**Calculation:**

Let a = 0.2 and b = 0.02

Using the formula a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

⇒ (0.2)³ - (0.02)³

⇒ (0.2 - 0.02)((0.2)² + 0.2 × 0.02 + (0.02)²)

⇒ 0.18(0.04 + 0.004 + 0.0004)

⇒ 0.18 × 0.0444

⇒ 0.007992

**The correct answer is option 3.**
